other_conditions: Must own agricultural land with irrigation sources
Land size must be between 0.4 and 4 hectares (for SC/ST and tribal area farmers the minimum area is 0.2 hectares)
Must install drip irrigation system; exemption applies for tribal area farmers with less than 0.4 hectares
Saplings must be purchased from accredited nurseries, government institutions or research centers
benefits_summary: Grants cover up to 50% of unit cost (max Rs 30,000 per hectare) for high‑value crops or up to 40% (max Rs 40,000 per hectare) for intensive horticultural orchards, with an additional 25% grant for small/marginal farmers.
